lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximate horizontal rows within the inter-carinal spaces posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs to create a faint grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient, exhibiting highlight on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark-pixel silhouettes (commensal remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region beneath the primary pectoral fin axis.
